    Retrieve RDF data from Skosmos

    Source: R/rdf.R
    skosmos_data.Rd

    Calls the global or vocabulary-specific Skosmos data route and returns the RDF serialization requested with format.

    Usage

    skosmos_data(
  client,
  uri = NULL,
  vocid = NULL,
  format = "text/turtle",
  parse = c("text", "raw")
)

    Arguments

    client

    A skosmos_client created with skosmos_client().

    uri

    Optional URI of a concept or other resource. When supplied, the response describes that resource.

    vocid

    Optional single vocabulary identifier. When supplied without uri, the function requests RDF for the complete vocabulary where the deployment supports vocabulary downloads.

    format

    RDF MIME type requested from Skosmos, for example "text/turtle", "application/rdf+xml", or "application/ld+json".

    parse

    Return type: "text" for a character string or "raw" for raw bytes.

    Value

    RDF content as a character string or raw vector.

    Details

    Use skosmos_vocabulary_data() when retrieving an entire vocabulary and skosmos_concept_data() when you already have a concept handle. Use skosmos_rdf() if you want the result parsed into an rdflib RDF object.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
finto <- skosmos_client("https://api.finto.fi/rest/v1/")

# Retrieve one concept as Turtle.
ttl <- skosmos_data(
  finto,
  uri = "http://www.yso.fi/onto/yso/p7160",
  vocid = "yso",
  format = "text/turtle"
)

# Retrieve the same resource as JSON-LD.
jsonld <- skosmos_data(
  finto,
  uri = "http://www.yso.fi/onto/yso/p7160",
  vocid = "yso",
  format = "application/ld+json"
)
} # }
